description: Sends one follow-up from the list, once: the saved reply while WhatsApp’s window to write freely is open, else the approved marketing template, as any message is sent. A customer who opted out is refused; one with no yes to offers on record gets the template, and the answer says so in warning. Without confirmation_token the call is a preview that returns what would happen and a token for a person to approve; called again with that token, it sends. Returns the messages sent.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The follow-up, by its adl_ id.

name: send_follow_up
title: Send a follow-up
